title: MapTeleport Component Schema
description: All MapTeleport custom action parameter definitions. Referenced by custom.action.schema.json.

MapTeleportSelectParam.description: Parameters for MapTeleportSelect: find the given teleport point on the open world map and click it.

zone.title: Zone
zone.description: Zone name, i.e. the directory name under assets/resource/image/MapLocator/.

target.title: Target
target.description: Teleport point [x, y] in that zone's base map pixel frame.

core.title: Core
core.description: The point is the zone's base teleport point, whose icon floats with the player's own placement. Optional, defaults to false.

max_attempts.title: Max Attempts
max_attempts.description: Recognition attempts. Panning the map is not charged against it. Optional, defaults to 4.

gate_base.title: Gate Base
gate_base.description: Maximum offset between the match and the expected position, in base map pixels. Ordinary anchors only. Optional, defaults to 10.0.
